ASM — Das Spiel: limited demo (rooms 1–5)

Limited demo (rooms 1–5): the original intro now launches the complete compiled main source. Choose JOY for the full view (IO Light intentionally shows half). Click through the opening messages, then use ⌨ to type the requested letter of ASM. Only rooms 1–5 are included. The demo ends before entering another room; later room assets and minigames are not bundled.

Controls

Use the mouse or touch to select commands and objects. Open ⌨ for text input; Enter and Backspace go directly to AMOS. Choose Keyboard: Typing to enter text; switch back to Keyboard: Joystick to play. Gamepad and touch controls work in both modes. Escape leaves fullscreen.
